Article id: configure-roles-and-permissions
Article: Assign user roles and configure permission levels
Protect sensitive clinical and financial data by tailoring access for your staff. Only practice managers and primary administrators can modify security credentials.

1. Go to **Settings > Practice Staff > Roles & Permissions**.
2. Click **Create New Role** or select an existing title from the directory.
3. Toggle permissions across categories, including *Billing*, *Patient Charts*, and *System Settings*.
4. Click **Assign Users**, select the staff members who require this profile, and click **Save Changes**.

**Limits & Conditions:** Every active user profile must be assigned to at least one role. Direct permission overrides on individual accounts are not permitted; all restrictions must flow through the assigned role.

**Troubleshooting:** If a staff member cannot view a restricted menu after saving, verify their account status is active and have them clear their browser cache before logging back in.

Ticket:
Questions on setting up user roles and permission levels

Hello, I am looking at the user management settings and I am feeling a bit confused about how to create custom security roles. I want to restrict access to certain financial and clinical records for our newer staff members, but the permission level toggles are not entirely clear to me. Could someone guide me through how to properly configure these roles without locking everyone out?

Auto-reply:
To create a custom security role, go to **Settings > Practice Staff > Roles & Permissions**. Click **Create New Role** (or pick an existing role) and use the toggles to enable or disable access to categories such as *Billing*, *Patient Charts*, and *System Settings* as needed. After setting the permissions, click **Assign Users**, select the staff members who should have this role, and press **Save Changes**. Remember that every active user must be assigned to at least one role, and you cannot set individual overrides outside the role. If a user still can’t see a menu, confirm their account is active and have them clear their browser cache before logging in again.
